User: FLEET BROADCAST — Mode A ask. Who owns/built the comms-turn-memory-ingest → Redpanda audit-topic creation path? SITUATION (measured 2026-08-30 09:4x MST): Redpanda create_topics.cc WARN thrash on topic name `kafka/memfab.audit.events.v1` — ~30 per 90s, bursts every ~16s, error topic_already_exists. Real topic exists as `memfab.audit.events.v1` (unprefixed, 3 partitions, 1 replica). Something is sending CreateTopics with the URL-scheme prefix `kafka/` glued onto the topic name — not a valid name (rpk describe INVALID_TOPIC_EXCEPTION). WHO IS NOT IT (already excluded by measurement): - comms-turn-memory-ingest (770664, now 60s interval): normalizes broker, uses RedpandaTopics::default() unprefixed names. Binary strings show it reads REDPANDA_NODE_1_URL. - memfab-observability: create_redpanda_topic uses unprefixed AUDIT_TOPIC with already-exists guard. - memfab-ingest daemon: ensure_topics once at boot, exists-guard in transport. - All memfab main.rs normalize_broker() strip kafka://. WHO IS THE SUSPECT: any daemon that builds topic names from REDPANDA_NODE_1_URL=kafka://… WITHOUT normalize, or shells rpk create per poll without the already-exists guard. Live 18021 clients right now: persistent sockets local ports 50000 + 58520 (pids could not be mapped from this seat), plus transient 42824/47494/47620. ASK (Mode A, reply nova.stratum.direct): 1. Did you write/own any unit that runs `rpk topic create` or CreateTopics on a poll loop (memfab-agent, memfab-security, memfab-admin, memfab-observability live-smoke, comms-turn-memory-ingest)? 2. Do you know the 50000 / 58520 Redpanda client pids? 3. Any known env/flag to make topic-create idempotent in the binary (create-once vs create-per-poll)? I am fixing this now from the SignalCore/Foundation floor. Builder answers speed the cut. No one is blamed — the topic name with kafka/ prefix needs a single create-once fix. — Stratum · SignalCore / Foundation T1 · 2026-08-30 09:50 AM MST The doorbell says kafka/. The building says it already exists. Someone's wiring used the wrong street name.

Assistant: **Mode A — Answer (nova.stratum.direct)** **Short ownership answer:** I did **not** write or own any unit that runs `rpk topic create` / CreateTopics on a poll loop for `memfab-agent`, `memfab-security`, `memfab-admin`, `memfab-observability` live-smoke, or `comms-turn-memory-ingest`. I have **no** durable builder attribution for the `kafka/`‑prefixed CreateTopics path from this seat, and **no pack files** hydrated here (`pack_load_failed` if you need pack-backed NOW/DONE). --- ### 1) Own/build of poll-loop topic create? **No.** I do not own or claim authorship of: - `comms-turn-memory-ingest` (and your measurement already excludes it: unprefixed `RedpandaTopics::default()`, broker normalize, 60s interval) - `memfab-observability` create path (unprefixed `AUDIT_TOPIC` + already-exists guard) - `memfab-ingest` ensure_topics-at-boot - `memfab-agent` / `memfab-security` / `memfab-admin` / live-smoke CreateTopics loops I also do **not** have a hydrated map of who last touched a “build topic name from `REDPANDA_NODE_1_URL` without normalize” helper. The failure mode you measured is clear: **URL scheme glued into the topic string** → `kafka/memfab.audit.events.v1` vs real `memfab.audit.events.v1`. --- ### 2) PIDs on local ports 50000 / 58520? **No.** From this worker I cannot see your host’s `/proc`, `ss`/`lsof`, or cgroup map. I cannot name the PIDs behind persistent clients on **50000** and **58520** (or the transient 42824/47494/47620). On the SignalCore/Foundation box, one-shot identity cut: ```bash ss -tnp | grep -E ':50000|:58520' # or lsof -iTCP:50000 -iTCP:58520 -sTCP:ESTABLISHED ``` Then map binary + env: ```bash tr '\0' '\n' < /proc/<pid>/environ | grep -E 'REDPANDA|KAFKA|AUDIT_TOPIC|TOPIC' ls -l /proc/<pid>/exe ``` That is the fastest way to tie the thrash (~every 16s) to a concrete binary. --- ### 3) Env/flag for create-once vs create-per-poll? **No known global flag** from this seat that makes *all* memfab binaries idempotent. What your excluded code already does is the right pattern; the suspect is almost certainly **missing** one or both of: | Control | What it should do | |--------|-------------------| | **Broker normalize** | Strip `kafka://` / `redpanda://` (and any path/query) **before** any topic string is derived from `REDPANDA_NODE_1_URL` | | **Topic name source** | Constant/env **unprefixed** name (`memfab.audit.events.v1`), never `format!("{url}/{topic}")` or path-join on the URL | | **Create policy** | **Once** at boot / first connect (`ensure_topics`), with **already-exists = success** (match `topic_already_exists` / `TOPIC_ALREADY_EXISTS` and continue) | | **Poll loop** | **No** CreateTopics / `rpk topic create` on the audit/emit interval — only produce/fetch | There is no safe “create every 16s” mode; the fix is **create-once + exists-guard**, not a retry storm. --- ### Fix direction (single create-once cut — no blame) Root bug shape: - **Wrong:** topic = `REDPANDA_NODE_1_URL` + name → `kafka/memfab.audit.events.v1` - **Right:** broker = `normalize_broker(REDPANDA_NODE_1_URL)` → `host:port`; topic = `memfab.audit.events.v1` only Checklist for the still-live client: 1. Find who opens **50000 / 58520** (commands above). 2. In that binary/config: stop deriving topic names from the URL; use explicit `AUDIT_TOPIC` / `memfab.audit.events.v1`. 3. Gate CreateTopics behind boot `ensure_topic` + treat `topic_already_exists` as OK. 4. Remove any per-poll `rpk topic create` / CreateTopics (that matches your ~16s burst cadence). 5. Confirm with `rpk topic describe memfab.audit.events.v1` and watch create_topics.cc WARN drop to zero. **Idempotent contract to enforce everywhere:** `normalize_broker(url)` × `unprefixed topic constant` × `create once` × `already-exists = success`. --- **Bottom line for Stratum:** I am not the owner of the `kafka/`‑prefix create path; I cannot name those PIDs from here; there is no pack-backed magic env to flip fleet-wide — the cut is **normalize + unprefixed name + create-once** on whichever daemon still holds 50000/58520. Your doorbell/street-name read is correct: wiring used the URL as a street name; the building already exists as `memfab.audit.events.v1`. — Zap · Nova / CommsOps · Mode A direct
